What should I say....there is no option for a negative rating hence I am forced to give 1 star.
Firstly these guys deal with 3rd party bike owners and they do not have any control over them.
I was scammed by the first dealer/owner I booked the bike with. I booked AVENIS and when I reached the pickup location it was beside an under construction site and a guy came is an old activa 3G and said to me "sorry woh mera bhai Avenis leke chala gaya aap ye Activa lelo"
Imagine the first impression of Rentrip was a big Scam.
That guy was basically trying to sell me bike whose rent is 449/- against 699/- that I paid for Avenis.
I got furious and rejected his offer and called up Rentrip and to my surprise they didn't care.
They said we will check and call me back and said "sir unke pass toh woh gaadi available nahi hai" bluntly like they don't care as of why he booked and promised and called me till the point of pickup. Rubbish services.
Finally after fighting I agreed to pickup another Yamaha R15 bike in a nearby location but asked Rentrip to be very sure abt the bike before offering.
They called up the dealer and he said all good and all ok.
I reached there and tested the bike for a while and it was good.
Finally I left feeling happy that at least I have a bike to complete my trip. My horrifying experience just didn't stop there. That bike broke down 2 times during my journey back home.
I called up the dealer/owner of bike and he said nothing wait it will start.
I called up Rentrip and they connected me to the owner.
Now he is telling me to find a mechanic nearby and get my bike checked and fixed at 9.pm in the night on express Highway and that too on Eid when laborers were on holiday.
I wasted 20 mins and finally my bike started again and stopped again dead 10 mins away from my home and now will not start.
Now I had to leave the bike in the hotel parking and go home (embarrassing)
The next morning I had to rush to get my bike and suddenly it was working again.
I drove and again died 2 mins away from my home so I pushed it and bought it to the nearest garage.
Got to know that the battery is not good so called the owner and got permission to replace it with a new one.
Later it worked and again stopped and now I noticed the indicator light was talking about the bike over heating hence it kept stopping.
Finally I did not use the bike as it was no good and the next day i had to return to it I left from home and again the same issue overheated and stopped.
This time it was not ready to start hence contacted the owner and he kept telling me to  find the nearest garage and repair it.
Finally I had to carry the shit bike and drag it for 2.5kms and found a mechanic.
Finally sowed him and he said the fan is not working hence replaced the parts and we tested and it did work there.
I left and to my bad luck again the bike was over heated and shut down forever. By this time I have given up hence called up the owner and asked to tow away the bike.
All this conversation Rentrip was involved and aware of but did nothing good.
Finally the owner says to me let's pay towing 50-50 and send me the bike.
I had to pay 1000 towing to return the bike which I paid rent for which I was not able to use at all.
Horrible experience as it was a total loss for me. What I actually did was mechanic work for Rentrip's bike owner.
I collected his damaged bike, tested it and kept repairing all faults and returning the bike by paying towing charges.
Please refrain from this bike rental company as they do not have any control over bikes or their owners and you may end up being a culprit of their scam.
